name: A89 Rosarian Hotel
detail: The location near the My Dinh Stadium is optimal. The room was modernly furnished, clean, and equipped with high-quality wooden flooring. Extremely professional staff and excellent value for money. Smooth process during check-in.

name: Hanoi Daewoo Hotel
detail: I stayed for 2 nights. The room was very spacious and comfortable. The breakfast had many options and was delicious. The pool was too cold to use at the end of October, but the jacuzzi was available and it felt almost private, which was excellent! The only downside was that there was a used dental cloth left next to the bedside lamp.

name: Palette Ngoc Ha Luxury Residence
detail: A worthwhile choice with a clean space, full amenities, and well-cared rooms. The bathroom is tidy, Wi-Fi works well, and transportation is quite convenient. The staff is friendly and very helpful, providing a comfortable stay experience. The location is fairly decent, although not the most convenient.

name: Bonjour D' An Nam Home
detail: It operates in conjunction with a brunch cafe on the first floor. The accommodation itself offers decent value for money, and the location is very good. Additionally, breakfast is provided at the brunch cafe, where you can choose one breakfast item and one drink, so you can enjoy unexpectedly good quality coffee in the morning. And since I arrived early in the morning, they tried to accommodate me for an early check-in as much as possible, which made for a comfortable stay. I think I will come back here if I have to stay in the Old Quarter again.

name: Madelise Hanoi View Hotel
detail: This hotel has a great location, convenient transportation, a clean environment, and the rooms are very well maintained in terms of cleanliness and facilities. The staff is warm and attentive, ensuring a comfortable stay. The sleep quality is good, and the hot water supply is stable, making guests feel relaxed and at ease. Overall, it offers excellent value for money and comes highly recommended.

name: Madelise Palace Hotel & Spa
detail: The location is the main one in the Old Quarter. Since it was the weekend, staff couldn't bring in the car, but they directly communicated with the Grab driver to take us with our luggage. The air conditioning and room conditions are not that great, but considering the price, it's satisfactory. I think I would go again if I went alone next time.

name: Quang Ba Trade Union Hotel
detail: A hotel by Lake Tai. It has a sense of history and is large and substantial. The rooms are old but clean, with bathtubs and spacious bathrooms. The hotel staff responds quickly when contacted. It is a taxi distance from the old town, but the area around the lakeside is also great for walks, and you can stroll while enjoying the night view (there's no sense of danger even at night). The breakfast buffet isn't very extensive, but you can enjoy freshly made pho, which is very nice. There is also a mart very close by where you can buy bottled drinks and snacks. Nearby, there is a Michelin Bib Gourmand restaurant where you can enjoy incredibly delicious food. It was a very good hotel for relaxing away from the hustle and bustle of the old town.
area: Tay Ho District,Hanoi - View on map

name: Achie Home - Ha Noi Old Quarter - Train Street
detail: This is my fourth time staying in Hanoi, but I didn't like the location. I think it depends on personal preference. There is a convenience store nearby, so it's easy to get water when needed. In the case of room 101, the private shower and toilet are outside the room next to the stairs. It was something I got used to, but I think some people might find it unpleasant. The room is spacious and the bed is large, which is sufficient for one person. I was connected with the staff via WhatsApp, so it was very easy to negotiate for an extended stay (however, bookings through the website are significantly cheaper, so I think there is some room for negotiation). The price is low considering the location, and the things I wanted were just right. The female staff member who was there in the morning greeted me with a smile, which really lifted my spirits.

name: Manevi Premier Hotel
detail: Had a really comfortable stay here. The room was spacious and clean, and the bed was comfortable. The bathroom was quite large, with a separate WC and shower area, as well as a bathtub. I also liked the fresh, five-star hotel scent of the towels, which smelled like they had been washed with good-quality detergent. One thing to note is that the WC, shower and main bathroom doors are all made of see-through glass, which might feel a little awkward if you’re not travelling as a couple. The smart TV came with plenty of apps, including Netflix and some free video on demand.  Breakfast was decent, with live stations for eggs and pho, and the breakfast staff were friendly and helpful. However, I would have liked to see more soup options, such as mushroom, seafood or miso soup, as I did not come across any of these during my seven-night stay. The hotel is located in a quieter part of the Old Quarter, but is still within a short walking distance of the night market and Beer Street. One area for improvement is the provision of only one hotel key card per room, which is something I rarely encounter in modern hotels. Having a second card would be more convenient, especially when travelling with someone else. Overall, a pleasant and comfortable stay. I would definitely consider staying here again!

name: Hanoi Railway Capsule
detail: This is a place where you can stay安心 regardless of the length of your stay. The staff is trustworthy, and you can easily consult them about anything. Upon check-in, you will be shown to your own shoe locker and locker. At that time, you can also borrow sandals. The area with rooms in the building is air-conditioned, and there are fans both in the rooms and in the dining area. The beds in the rooms are large, and there are sliding doors and curtains, so you don’t have to worry about privacy. For safety, there are surveillance cameras installed inside the building, and the gates are locked at night, providing peace of mind. Breakfast is provided every day in a paper bag and is placed in front of your room. You can eat at any time you like, allowing you to move at your own pace. Convenience stores, food stalls, dining spots, and tourist attractions are all within walking distance. If you know the way, you can reach it from Hanoi Station in about 10 to 15 minutes. The cost performance is good, and it's cheap yet clean and safe. You can use this accommodation as a base to join day tours or excursions to the suburbs. You need to bring your own bath towels, while shampoo and body soap are provided in the shower room. There’s also a laundry nearby, so large laundry items are not a problem. The staff is really kind and helped me during my stay.
